subject: project:gdl
value: Two apparent undefined source functions were actually referenced by retained extracted jump tables. Making them public would only conceal the data-ownership defect. Shop and mb_particle now own the four generated switch tables they emit (316 and68 bytes), so editable source links use compiler-generated branch offsets without changing C function visibility or raw code. A joint selected-source full-image link now succeeds; this is not a whole-project source link, TU flip, runtime test or proof that all cases are semantically exact.
